## 10 Major Practice Divisions (120 Lawsuits)
1. Family, Personal Status & Inheritance Court (29 Lawsuits): Divorce, Khul', Ja'fari Code, custody, alimony, wills, estates, DNA.
2. Criminal Defense, Investigation & Felonies (32 Proceedings): Bail, homicide, narcotics (Law 50/2017), money laundering, cyber extortion, forged deeds, tribal threats (دگة عشائرية), Article 4 terrorism.
3. Civil & Real Estate Court (21 Lawsuits): Property partition (إزالة الشيوع), eviction, Decision 1198/1977, compensation, medical malpractice.
4. Corporate, Commercial & Intellectual Property (7 Lawsuits): Company liquidation, arbitration, franchise, trademarks, partner disputes.
5. Labor Court & Social Security (5 Lawsuits): Unfair dismissal, work injuries, end-of-service bonuses, inspection appeals.
6. Residency, Foreign Labor & Border Law (4 Proceedings): Deportation cancellation, visa fines, foreign labor status regularization.
7. Administrative Court & State Council (6 Lawsuits): Civil servant disciplinary appeals, job termination, ministerial inquiries, tenders.
8. Execution Directorates & Debt Recovery (7 Proceedings): Bounced checks (Article 459), asset freezing, travel bans, debtor detention.
9. Military & Internal Security Forces Courts (3 Proceedings): Ministry of Interior & Defense courts, disciplinary councils, wounded rights.
10. Federal Cassation & Constitutional Court (6 High Appeals): Cassation appeals, Decision 216 appeals, Federal Supreme Court constitutional lawsuits.
